title: Create Tidy Long-Format Peak Table with Optional Annotations — tidy_peaklist
text: tibble::tibble long format one row per feature per sample (one row per peak per sample features defined). tibble contains following columns data types: feature_id integer: Feature identifier (1, 2, 3, ...). present features defined via xcms::groupChromPeaks(). f_mzmed, f_mzmin, f_mzmax numeric: Feature-level m/z statistics (median, minimum, maximum). present features defined. f_rtmed, f_rtmin, f_rtmax numeric: Feature-level retention time statistics seconds (median, minimum, maximum). present features defined. ms_level integer: MS level (typically 1 MS1 features). present features defined. isotopes character: Isotope annotations CAMERA syntax (e.g., ""[1][M]+"", ""[1][M+1]+""). Present xsAnnotate provided xcms::featureDefinitions() isotopes column (e.g. IonFamilies::annotateIsotopes()). adduct character: Adduct annotations CAMERA syntax (e.g., ""[M+H]+ 169.037""). Present xsAnnotate provided xcms::featureDefinitions() adduct column (e.g. IonFamilies::annotateAdducts()). pcgroup integer: Pseudospectrum group ID CAMERA. Features pcgroup believed originate compound. present xsAnnotate provided. feature_group character: Feature group identifier MsFeatures::groupFeatures() (e.g., "FG.001", "FG.002"). Features feature_group believed originate compound. present groupFeatures applied. mz, mzmin, mzmax numeric: Peak m/z values (centroid, minimum, maximum). rt, rtmin, rtmax numeric: Peak retention time seconds (apex, minimum, maximum). numeric: Integrated peak intensity (integrated area original (raw) peak). intb numeric: Baseline-corrected integrated peak intensity. maxo numeric: Maximum peak intensity (apex). sn numeric: Signal--noise ratio. is_filled logical: Whether peak gap-filled (TRUE) originally detected (FALSE). filepath character: Full file path raw data file. filename character: Basename raw data file. fromFile numeric: Sample index (1-based) corresponding order xcms::fileNames,MsExperiment-method. peakidx numeric: Internal peak index xcms::chromPeaks(). Additional columns Variable types: columns Biobase::pData() MsExperiment::sampleData() included original data types.

title: Create Tidy Long-Format Peak Table with Optional Annotations — tidy_peaklist
text: function integrates data multiple sources: Chromatographic peaks xcms::chromPeaks() Feature definitions xcms::featureDefinitions() (available) Feature intensities xcms::featureValues() (features defined) CAMERA annotations xsAnnotate object (provided) Sample metadata Biobase::pData() MsExperiment::sampleData() function supports xcms::XCMSnExp xcms::XcmsExperiment objects, providing flexibility modern XCMS workflows. Feature grouping optional: xcms::groupChromPeaks() run, function return peak-level data , without feature-level aggregation. Intensity matching: multiple peaks sample assigned single feature, XCMS parameter (method = "maxint") selects peak intensity use. function filters peaks match intensity values XCMS selected, ensuring consistency XCMS's feature intensity matrix. Missing values (NA) indicate feature detected particular sample.

title: Create Tidy Long-Format Peak Table with Optional Annotations — tidy_peaklist
text: XCMS sometimes creates duplicate peaks; function keeps first occurrence. function uses "maxint" method feature values, meaning takes maximum intensity peak feature sample. CAMERA annotations optional. xsAnnotate NULL, isotopes adduct columns present already xcms::featureDefinitions(), pcgroup present. MsFeatures grouping automatically detected. MsFeatures::groupFeatures() applied object, feature_group column included output. XcmsExperiment objects, sample metadata accessed via sampleData() instead pData(). large datasets (many features x many samples), output can memory-intensive. warning issued expected output exceeds 10 million rows.
